连一个初阶魔法师都成为不了？
老子呵呵你一脸！！
莫凡承认自己在有一段时间和小公主穆宁走得很近很近，但年幼的他根本不知道这会给自己这个贫苦家庭带来一场灾难，从那一天起莫凡就知道这个社会依旧存在着三六九等。
“莫凡，哈哈哈，你的事情解决啦，我打电话给我一个老朋友，原来他现在可牛B了，是天澜高中的教导处主任，他说只要你好好修炼，他可以让你进天澜魔法高中，让你觉醒你命中的那一系魔法，这种机会可是一辈子才一次，这次你一定要努力，知道吗？”脸色蜡黄莫家兴满脸笑容的走了进来，手掌拍在莫凡的肩膀上。
莫凡看着老爸的喜悦笑容，换作平常莫凡也会高兴的和老爸喝一周白酒庆祝一下，可在知道真相后的他哪里还相信得了老爸这忠厚得爽朗大笑，更让莫凡不愿意去相信自己尊敬的老爸其实在这个社会从来就没有被人尊重过。
“真的吗，那太好了，不愧是我老爸，什么事情都能够搞定，哈哈。”终于，莫凡也换上了一张笑脸，跟自己老爹勾肩搭背了起来。
“那是当然，也不看你爸是谁？”莫家兴觉得这小子马屁拍的不错，脸上的笑容就更多了。
两父子晚上还是喝了几杯，喝酒过程中莫家兴用委婉的说道：“莫凡啊，你就直接住校，我打算把家租出去，给我们生活多点补贴。”
莫凡其实也知道，这个家相当于卖给穆贺了，这个破屋子不值钱，但这块地在城区却价格很高。
“行啊，租出去吧，反正我也很少回来，就是心夏那边……”莫凡佯装不知的说道。
“心夏就在你姨姨那了，说实话我们两个大男人也不好照顾心夏，这丫头懂事，不用我们担心太多。”莫家兴说道。
“那行，你记得多来学校看我。”莫凡说道。
“知道了，困了困了，我先睡了，你明天就去学校吧。”莫家兴喝掉了最后一口白酒，有些摇摇晃晃的站了起来。
莫凡看着他转身，看着这个背影突然间想起了朱自清的那篇文章。
自己住校，心夏住姨姨家，两个孩子都安顿好了，那么这个中年人该住哪？
最后莫凡也没有说穿这件事。
事实上，莫家兴愿意做出这样的牺牲来对他来说是一种做父亲的职责和荣耀，他想让自己的儿子知道，你放心的去学，你解决不了的事情我会帮你解决。
而莫凡也知道，把事情说穿了，只会让莫家兴感到悲凉和无地自容，毕竟哪个男人不想做一个什么事情都可以为儿子摆平的牛B老爸？
莫凡不能说穿，别人可以不尊重老爸，但自己不可以！
这小破屋，不住就不住了，最多三年，等自己魔法大乘，什么都会有的。

这个社会，魔法为尊！
自己也一定会成为顶天立地的法师尊者！
暑期两个月时间过得飞快，莫凡感觉整个人都掉进书海里了。
天澜魔法高中的图书馆什么书都有，而有关魔法学的书更是跟科学一样复杂、众多，是真正意义上的学海无涯。
不过，莫凡已经收获很大了，至少他已经不再是文盲……哦，魔法盲了，九年义务魔法教育教的东西莫凡基本上掌握，大有张无忌乾坤大挪移神功炼成脚踏光明鼎的气势了。
九月一号开学，开学这天对所有魔法学生来说都是无比重大的日子，因为这不仅关系到所有学生踏入魔法师的最重要一步，更关系到了学生们将成为哪一系的魔法师！
觉醒，顾名思义，就是让身体里潜在的力量苏醒过来。
“小鬼，祝你好运啊，最好觉醒一个火炎系，这会让你在魔法学生里面占很大的便宜，至于其他系虽然也还可以，但从初阶魔法师战斗力来说还是火系最好，哦，岩系也不错……风系也可以……”图书馆总管理顾老头说道。
莫凡应了一声，没理会他了，这老头说起话来没完没了。
说实话，莫凡昨晚一整夜没睡，对他来说今天的觉醒不单单是一次命运的改变，更是前所未有的尝试，在原来的世界里魔法这种东西是不可能存在的啊，今天自己就可以真心实意的握住了。
小心脏是活蹦乱跳的！

content_en:
Can't even become a junior magician?
I’m hehe, you look like that! !
Mo Fan admitted that he had been very close to the little princess Mu Ning for a while, but when he was young, he had no idea that this would bring a disaster to his poor family. From that day on, Mo Fan knew that there were still classes of people in this society.
"Mo Fan, hahaha, your matter is solved. I called an old friend of mine. It turns out that he is awesome now. He is the director of the Tianlan High School's Education Department. He said that as long as you practice well, he can let you enter Tianlan Magic High School and let you awaken the magic you are destined for. This opportunity only comes once in a lifetime. You must work hard this time, understand?" Mo Jiaxing, with a sallow face, walked in with a smile on his face and patted Mo Fan on the shoulder.
Mo Fan looked at his father's joyful smile. Normally, Mo Fan would be happy to celebrate with his father by drinking liquor for a week. But after knowing the truth, he could not believe that his father was so loyal and hearty. He laughed even more, which made Mo Fan unwilling to believe that the father he respected had never been respected in this society.
"Really? That's great. As expected of my dad, he can handle anything, haha." Finally, Mo Fan put on a smiling face and started hooking up with his dad.
"Of course, it doesn't matter who your father is?" Mo Jiaxing felt that this boy was a good flatterer, and the smile on his face became even bigger.
The two father and son still had a few drinks in the evening. During the drinking process, Mo Jiaxing said tactfully: "Mo Fan, you can live on campus directly. I plan to rent out the house to give us more subsidies for life."
Mo Fan actually also knew that this house was equivalent to being sold to Mu He. This shabby house was worthless, but the land price in the city was very high.
"Okay, let's rent it out. I rarely come back anyway, just to Xinxia..." Mo Fan said, pretending not to know.
"Xinxia is with your aunt. To be honest, it's not easy for us two grown men to take care of Xinxia. This girl is sensible and we don't need to worry too much." Mo Jiaxing said.
"Okay, remember to come to school to see me more often." Mo Fan said.
"I know, I'm tired. I'm going to sleep first. You can go to school tomorrow." Mo Jiaxing drank the last sip of liquor and stood up unsteadily.
Mo Fan watched him turn around. Looking at the figure from behind, he suddenly remembered Zhu Ziqing's article.
He lives on campus, Xinxia lives at his aunt's house, and the two children are settled, so where should this middle-aged man live?
In the end, Mo Fan did not tell the truth.
In fact, Mo Jiaxing's willingness to make such a sacrifice is a father's duty and honor to him. He wants his son to know that you can study with confidence, and I will help you solve things you can't solve.
And Mo Fan also knows that telling the truth will only make Mo Jiaxing feel sad and ashamed. After all, what man doesn't want to be a great father who can settle everything for his son?
Mo Fan couldn't put it bluntly. Others can disrespect his father, but he can't!
If you don't want to live in this small shabby house, you won't be able to live in it. It will take at most three years, and you will have everything you need when you wait for your magic Mahayana.
In this society, magic is respected!
I will definitely become an upright Dharma Master!
The two months of summer vacation passed so quickly, Mo Fan felt like he had fallen into a sea of ​​books.
The library of Tianlan Magic High School has all kinds of books, and the books on magic are as complicated and numerous as science. It is a truly boundless sea of ​​learning.
However, Mo Fan has gained a lot, at least he is no longer illiterate... Oh, he is magic-illiterate. Mo Fan has basically mastered the things taught in the nine-year compulsory magic education. He is very capable of mastering Zhang Wuji's Great Movement of the Universe and the Light Cauldron.
School starts on September 1st, and this day is an extremely important day for all magic students, because it not only affects all studentsThe most important step for students to become magicians is also related to which type of magicians the students will become!
Awakening, as the name suggests, is to awaken the potential power in the body.
"Kid, I wish you good luck. It's best to awaken a fire element, which will give you a big advantage among magic students. As for the other elements, although they are okay, in terms of the combat effectiveness of junior magicians, the fire element is the best. Oh, the rock element is also good... the wind element is also okay..." Old Man Gu, the general manager of the library, said.
Mo Fan responded and ignored him. The old man talked endlessly.
To be honest, Mo Fan didn't sleep all night last night. For him, today's awakening is not only a change of fate, but also an unprecedented attempt. In the original world, magic is impossible to exist. Today, he can grasp it sincerely.
The little heart is beating wildly!
